sources.title: Install Delta — Delta Docs
sources.finding: macOS13+ Apple Silicon, Linux glibc x86_64/ARM64 and Windows x86_64/ARM64. Zed account and Early Access Agreement required.

sources.title: Quick Start — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Prerequisites: sign in, connect a model and use the top-level folder of a Git repository with a configured remote; Isolated Delta Worktree separates thread changes but does not sandbox the agent.

sources.title: Models & Providers — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Native Delta agents use hosted models, supported subscription logins, API keys or local LM Studio/Ollama. Credentials/settings sync through account.

sources.title: Plans & Usage — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Zed plans/credits cover Delta. BYOK and supported provider subscriptions are separate from hosted token credits/spend limits.

sources.title: Get Started with Delta CLI — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Beta CLI reads/searches/creates/shares/forks threads, manages worktree sync and sends attributed inter-agent messages. Query does not run coding tasks.

sources.title: Claude Code Plugin — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Official beta Claude Code plugin shares conversation/files through Delta; joining creates a new Claude session with bounded imported context.

sources.title: Build a Coding Agent Plugin — Delta Docs
sources.finding: External session plugins use Delta CLI synchronization; main Delta agent is separate.

sources.title: Subagents — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Native Worker/Scout/Reviewer profiles create nested conversations, communicate and return results. Scout/Reviewer lack edit tools but bash can still write.

sources.title: Collaborate in a Thread — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Collaborators co-prompt/edit/comment with author attribution. Sending submits all trailing drafts and bills sender; machine-local runtime does not sync.

sources.title: Delta on the Web — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Browser works with replicated files/diffs and no local checkout/shell. iOS/Android can install web app to home screen.

sources.title: Delta Worktrees — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Default isolated DeltaDB checkouts are not Git worktrees. Desktop may use primary checkout or an existing linked Git worktree.

sources.title: Delta & Git — Delta Docs
sources.finding: DeltaDB records edits between commits and syncs participants; project folders need top-level Git checkout and configured source remote.

sources.title: Reviewing & Syncing Changes — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Review subthreads keep original context and isolated files, return verdicts and selected fixes. Merge skills control landing; PR through origin remains supported.

sources.title: Comments — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Humans comment on conversation/files/diffs with agent-linked replies.

sources.title: Skills — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Project/personal Markdown skills provide workflows; browser cannot use machine-local personal skills.

sources.title: MCP Servers — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Product MCP clients connect external tools using configured endpoints and authentication.

sources.title: Prepare your project — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Repository preparation and configured project settings determine checkout setup.

sources.title: Settings — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Legacy attached subagents have default 4-per-parent/8-overall limits that do not apply to new subthreads. Terminal command cap is configurable; runners settings require private-beta access.

sources.title: Data Storage & Deletion — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Server stores repository Git objects, deltas, settings and encrypted OAuth grants on Cloudflare. Local thread deletion does not reliably delete server history.

sources.title: AI Privacy & Telemetry — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Vendor says no training on code/conversations. Account-associated telemetry and Sentry reporting have no disable setting; crash dumps can contain thread content.

sources.title: Security — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Backend traffic/storage encrypted; recognized secrets redacted before sync/model requests, with defined unredaction controls.

sources.title: Agentic Safety — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Public beta has no agent permission system or sandbox, and repository preparation/config can run without trust prompt.

sources.title: Cloud Runners — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Private-beta Cloud Runners and Personal Runner settings are access-gated. Linux cloud sandbox sizes/setup/secrets and continued work during laptop sleep are documented only for those participants.

sources.title: Release notes — Delta Docs
sources.finding: Current release documents organization Overview, CLI messaging, MCP bearer/header auth and subthread merge actions.

sources.title: Delta — Pricing
sources.finding: Personal $0 supports BYOK/external agents; Pro $10/month includes $5 hosted tokens. Two-week Pro trial needs no card.

sources.title: Building fine-grained version control for agents with Rust and Durable Objects — Delta Blog
sources.finding: Vendor technical article describes Delta native UI and Rust DeltaDB architecture; no independent responsiveness result.

sources.title: Replacing Pull Requests with Delta
sources.locator: Opening section; Code review without pull requests
sources.finding: Public-beta announcement says teammates can keep working with the agent after the thread author logs off, and review subthreads have access to the original agent context with an isolated copy of the parent worktrees.
